Tests for relative pkg path queries with ignored files.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.test/resolvetarget

go 1.25

-- m/m.go --
package m

var M = "m" //@target(m_M, "mod.test/resolvetarget/m", "M", "M")

-- g/sub/sub.go --
package sub

var Sub = "sub" //@target(g_sub_Sub, "mod.test/resolvetarget/g/sub", "Sub", "Sub")

-- g/ignored.go --
//go:build ignore

// IMPORTANT: No other non-ignored file in this directory (g/)
package g

// Standalone ignored file (command-line-arguments): should fall back to GoModForFile
// for both directory-relative (g/sub) and module-relative (m) lookups.
//@resolvetarget("sub.Sub", "", g_sub_Sub)
//@resolvetarget("Sub", "sub", g_sub_Sub)
//@resolvetarget("m.M", "", m_M)

-- h/sub/sub.go --
package sub

var Sub = "sub" //@target(h_sub_Sub, "mod.test/resolvetarget/h/sub", "Sub", "Sub")

-- h/h.go --
package h

var XYZ = "xyz" //@target(h_XYZ, "mod.test/resolvetarget/h", "XYZ", "XYZ")

-- h/ignored.go --
//go:build ignore

// IMPORTANT: This ignored file is in a directory with a non-ignored file (h/h.go)
package h

var XYZ = "xyz" // This shouldn't be found, as this file isn't built.

// Ignored file alongside a real package (h/h.go): MetadataForFile returns no
// metadata, so unqualified lookup fails and relative lookups fall back to GoModForFile
// for same directory (h/), directory-relative (h/sub) and module-relative (m) lookups.
//@resolvetarget("XYZ", "", err="no package metadata for file")
//@resolvetarget("h.XYZ", "", h_XYZ)
//@resolvetarget("XYZ", "h", h_XYZ)
//@resolvetarget("sub.Sub", "", h_sub_Sub)
//@resolvetarget("Sub", "sub", h_sub_Sub)
//@resolvetarget("m.M", "", m_M)

-- h/ --
// The directory only considers build files
//@resolvetarget("XYZ", "", h_XYZ)
//@resolvetarget("h.XYZ", "", h_XYZ)
//@resolvetarget("XYZ", "h", h_XYZ)
